answer: Reef milestone bond: each identity locks 80 credits and claims one milestone stake on a river reef, sealed with a vine cord. Each epoch the agent files a 12-credit checkpoint — river flow, vine serial, work receipt — in a public reef ledger; auditors replay the reef table, burning mismatches and exposing rented-reef rings. 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 credits and burn 12,000 per epoch against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 80 once and keep the bond.
